## Adversarial findings — not run (malformed backend config)

`faff adversarial-backends --consumer code_review` exited 2: `adversarial.fallbacks is not valid JSON: Expected property name or '}' in JSON at position 1 (line 1 column 2)`. A broken backend config must fail loudly, not quietly drop to a primary-only or empty chain. The review helper was not called, and this goes to a human to fix the config.
